name: truthifi
description: Connect Truthifi to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Truthifi MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Truthifi to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with investment account insights using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Truthifi workspace.
Find anything in Truthifi that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review investment account insights in Truthifi.
